No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

In this workshop you practise baseline mapping and manual documentation.

All materials are provided. The session is adapted to your space, your timetable and the age of the participants.

What it covers

  • Scale and symbols
  • Measured drawing
  • Digital transfer

How the time is spent

  1. Scale and symbols 35 min

    North arrows, scale bars, offsets.

    You: base map

  2. Measured drawing 110 min

    Sketch approved safe viewpoint or classroom replica.

    You: dimension sheet

  3. Digital transfer 35 min

    Reconcile sketch and photos.

    You: clean annotated plan

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Draw a base map with a north arrow, scale bar and offsets.
  • Make a measured drawing from a safe viewpoint or a classroom replica.
  • Reconcile a field sketch with photographs to produce a clean annotated plan.

You take away

An activity sheet to keep.
